description: Elastic ($m_Y=m_p$) and proton-dissociative ($1<m_Y<10$ GeV) $\rho^0(770)$ photoproduction cross section off protons, single differential in the momentum transfer $\vert t\vert$ and in bins of the photon-proton energy $W$ --- statistical correlations coefficients $\rho_{ij}$ only. Only one half of the (symmetric) matrix is stored. Bins are identified by their global bin number.
location: statistical correlation coefficients corresponding to the data of Table 12-13 and Figure 17 of arxiv:2005.14471
name: Table 12-13 statistical correlations
